item.title: Trump dominates CPAC poll as conservatives rally behind agenda, back Iran action
item.summary: A new CPAC survey finds strong conservative backing for Trump's agenda, with 91% supporting tariffs and 89% backing military action in Iran.

item.title: Rand Paul says he's '50-50' on running for president in 2028, 'thinking about it'
item.summary: Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., told "CBS News Sunday Morning" that he is "50-50" on a possible 2028 presidential run based on his opposition to the war against Iran.

item.title: Why Meta and Google are losing court battles for damaging kids by trying to get them addicted
item.summary: Juries ordered Meta and Google to pay millions over child safety failures, raising urgent questions about Big Tech accountability and congressional inaction.

item.title: Howie Mandel says sorry to Kelly Ripa after awkward 'Live With Kelly and Mark' moment
item.summary: Howie Mandel says sorry to Kelly Ripa on Instagram after a joke on "Live With Kelly and Mark" didn't land, but ends his apology with a humorous twist.

item.title: Marlins deliver walk-off win as team's teal jerseys make season debut
item.summary: The Miami Marlins' nostalgic teal jerseys made their season debut on Sunday and it came with a walk-off win against the Colorado Rockies.

item.title: Passenger bomb threat triggers police response and evacuation on Frontier flight under investigation
item.summary: A Frontier Airlines passenger allegedly made a bomb threat on Flight 2539 at Atlanta's airport Sunday, prompting a law enforcement response before the threat was deemed non-credible.

item.title: Lionel Richie issues warning to rude celebrities after Chappell Roan backlash
item.summary: Lionel Richie warns rising stars to embrace fan support, saying fame without people "doesn't work," amid Chappell Roan's Brazil fan incident controversy.

item.title: Trump claims donor funded White House ballroom includes hidden build below with security focus
item.summary: A $400 million White House ballroom approved by the Commission of Fine Arts will include an underground complex, Trump says, funded by private donors.

item.title: Rob Schneider proposes military draft, urges Americans to 'recommit' to traditional values
item.summary: Actor Rob Schneider invoked a JFK quote on X while calling for restoring the military draft, urging every American to serve two years of service at 18.

item.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to what to expect on DHS funding when the Senate meets Monday
item.summary: The Senate could end the DHS shutdown Monday via unanimous consent on the House bill, but a single objection from any senator could keep it frozen.
